title: Semi-Linear Gaussian Bayesian Networks: Enhancing Flexibility in Node Dependencies via penalized B-Splines
abstract: arXiv:2610.30838v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian networks for continuous variables often rely on restrictive assumptions: linear Gaussian models lack flexibility to capture nonlinear dependencies, while non-parametric approaches provide greater flexibility at a high computational cost. This creates a gap for modeling scenarios where variables are approximately Gaussian but exhibit nonlinear relationships. We introduce Semi-Linear Gaussian Bayesian Networks (SLGBN), a novel class of continuous Bayesian networks designed to bridge this gap, preserving Gaussian conditional distributions while introducing nonlinear conditional mean functions. The proposed framework provides a unified probabilistic framework combining linear Gaussian and nonlinear Gaussian conditional models within the same Bayesian network Nonlinear conditional mean functions are estimated using generalized additive models (GAMs) with penalized B-splines. We present parameter estimation procedures for both types

translated_title: 半线性高斯贝叶斯网络：通过惩罚B样条增强节点依赖关系的灵活性
translated_abstract: 用于连续变量的贝叶斯网络通常依赖于严格的假设：线性高斯模型缺乏捕捉非线性依赖关系的灵活性，而非参数方法虽然提供了更大的灵活性，但计算成本高昂。这在建模变量近似服从高斯分布但呈现非线性关系的场景时造成了一个空白。我们提出了半线性高斯贝叶斯网络（SLGBN），这是一类新颖的连续贝叶斯网络，旨在弥合这一空白，它在保持高斯条件分布的同时引入了非线性条件均值函数。所提出的框架提供了一个统一的概率框架，将线性高斯和非线性高斯条件模型结合在同一个贝叶斯网络中。非线性条件均值函数使用带惩罚B样条的广义可加模型（GAMs）进行估计。我们给出了两种类型模型的参数估计方法。
tldr: 本文提出了半线性高斯贝叶斯网络（SLGBN），通过带惩罚B样条的广义可加模型估计非线性条件均值函数，在保持高斯条件分布的同时捕捉非线性依赖关系，弥合了线性高斯模型灵活性不足与非参数方法计算成本高之间的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Semi-Linear Gaussian Bayesian Networks (SLGBN), a novel class of continuous Bayesian networks that preserves Gaussian conditional distributions while capturing nonlinear dependencies through GAMs with penalized B-splines, bridging the gap between the inflexibility of linear Gaussian models and the high computational cost of non-parametric approaches.
